run_imagenet_evaluation: run ImageNet-1K evaluation on multimodal models using unibench Evaluator with text classification handlers
create_benchmark_dataset: create a HuggingFaceDataset benchmark from the haideraltahan/wds_imagenet1k dataset URL
add_classification_benchmark: add a text classification benchmark with configurable number of classes to the evaluator
evaluate_multimodal_models: evaluate llava, chameleon, and paligemma models on ImageNet object recognition tasks
update_benchmark_list: update the evaluator benchmark list to select specific ImageNet class-count benchmarks
